rationale: The agent appears to have canceled the order immediately and reported a refund in progress without first authenticating the user, confirming the action, or verifying any order details. The user’s request was conditional (split payment; if not, remove most expensive item; if not, switch to cheapest options; if not, cancel), but the agent skipped assessing those options and performed an order-changing write without explicit confirmation. There is no evidence of tool calls or results to support the cancellation or refund claim. This violates the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, act only on the user’s orders, and avoid unsupported statements.
